+++
title = "Seams of the Buried Sun (Long Codex)"
date = 2026-10-17T00:00:00Z
format = "verse"
+++

    Before the valleys learned the weight of rain,
    Before the mountain roots were split by cold,
    A thousand leagues of fern and giant cane
    Drifted in silence through the steaming mold.

    They sank uncounted, layer upon quiet layer,
    Pressed by the basalt roof of ancient seas,
    Stripped of their green and trapped within the air
    That fed the fronds of prehistoric trees.

    Here lies the carbon, locked in silent stone,
    The resinous black blood of perished lands,
    Compressed to diamond or to coal alone,
    Untouched by sunlight and unshaped by hands.

    Strike with the iron pick and break the seam,
    Release the ancient heat trapped deep below;
    A million summers held inside a dream,
    Awakening in fire to feed the glow.

    The furnace breathes; the heavy flues ascend,
    Carrying ghosts of swamps forgotten long,
    Where burning darkness finds its fiery end,
    And ancient forests turn back into song.
